GET A QUOTE

A CLEAR SCOPE

What your service quote covers

Agree the locations, visit frequency, flag supply, replacement work and checks to be performed. Access arrangements, reporting and any separately quoted repairs are identified before the program starts.

Start with these details

  • City or site address and preferred dates.
  • Number of poles, approximate height and what needs doing.
  • Ground-level photos and any existing product records.

AGREED SCOPE. PRACTICAL CARE.

More than a flag change.

Build a scope covering flag condition, scheduled replacement, damaged flags, visual pole checks, halyard and hardware inspection, or raising and lowering. Frequency and included tasks are agreed for each property.
